name: house-models
description: Scale models of real homes from PDF building plans. One Cloudflare Worker: site, order store and plan reading.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key, from console.anthropic.com under API keys. It starts with sk-ant-. Plan reads are billed to it.

ADMIN_PASSCODE.description: Make up a long passcode. You type it on the site to open the owner queue.
